concept.concept: Warm-toned block print style illustration of pumpkins, dried corn, and sunflowers arranged in a wreath with 'Harvest Season' in rustic woodblock lettering
concept.audience: Women aged 25-50 who decorate for fall and enjoy seasonal lifestyle content
concept.rationale: September-October is a peak buying season and the 6-8 week lead time from late July aligns perfectly, fall harvest aesthetics drive strong organic search volume on Etsy and Amazon Merch

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Harvest Season" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a circular wreath composed of pumpkins, dried corn husks, and sunflowers arranged in a balanced composition. Solid color blocks with no gradients, no shading, no photorealism, clean sharp edges. Color palette: burnt orange, golden yellow, deep rust red, sage green, cream. Single centered wreath on a plain solid cream background with generous margin. Screen-print aesthetic with bold simple shapes. High contrast. Design readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.style: Bold rustic woodblock serif lettering arched above the wreath in burnt orange, heavy weight, distressed edges to suggest carved wood texture

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Harvest Season' is a common generic seasonal expression with no well-known trademark associations in the decorative or apparel space. The design elements — pumpkins, dried corn, sunflowers in a wreath — are entirely generic fall harvest imagery with no connection to protected characters, brands, or properties. The block print and woodblock lettering style is a widely used folk art aesthetic. No IP concerns identified.

image_verdict.reason: The design clearly displays 'HARVEST SEASON' in correctly spelled, bold lettering arranged in an arch. The illustration features generic fall harvest motifs (pumpkins, sunflowers, corn) in a clean flat vector style with no IP concerns. Text is complete, legible, and properly rendered. Suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Harvest Season Wreath T-Shirt | Fall Block Print

'Harvest Season' appears in rustic woodblock lettering. Perfect for women who love decorating for fall and embrace seasonal living.
